landing.ai_privacy: To answer questions, the AI only receives the file structure, statistics and 5 sample rows; the math runs in your browser. Automations send only the columns and rows you choose.
landing.ai_sub: Tasks that would take hours become a new column in seconds. You pick the columns and rows; the AI does the rest.

landing.eyebrow: Spreadsheets + AI, right in your browser
landing.f_charts_desc: Bar, line, area, pie and scatter charts, with date grouping and PNG download.
landing.f_clean_desc: Remove duplicates and empty rows, fix spacing and casing, split columns, find and replace.
landing.f_edit_desc: Create, edit and delete rows and columns, paste from Excel, work with multiple sheets and undo any step.
landing.f_export_desc: Excel (.xlsx), CSV with ; or , that opens cleanly in Excel, or JSON. Only filtered rows, if you like.
landing.f_filter_desc: Filter by values or conditions, search across all columns and sort with one click.
landing.f_formulas_desc: Formulas like IF, SUM, TEXT and DATE, just like Excel — or describe what you need and AI writes it for you.
landing.f_pivot_desc: Summarize by any column with sum, average, count, median and more — and turn the result into a new sheet.
landing.f_profile_desc: See fill rate, duplicates, top values and the distribution of every column.
landing.faq1_a: No. Quosheets runs in your browser (Chrome, Edge, Firefox or Safari) on a computer or tablet. Just create an account and open your file.
landing.faq1_q: Do I need to install anything?
landing.faq2_a: Not for editing, filtering, charting or exporting: everything happens in your browser and files stay saved on your device. Only when you use AI is the data needed for that task sent for processing.
landing.faq2_q: Are my files uploaded to a server?
landing.faq3_a: CSV and TSV (any delimiter and encoding), Excel (.xlsx, .xlsm, .xls), OpenDocument (.ods) and JSON. It exports to Excel, CSV and JSON.
landing.faq4_a: Files up to 150 MB. Because the grid only draws what is on screen, hundreds of thousands of rows stay smooth — the real limit is your computer’s memory.
landing.faq4_q: What is the maximum file size?
landing.faq5_a: Your subscription includes {credits} credits per month, renewed every cycle. Each use is charged by the actual size of the task, and you see an estimate before running an automation. The free trial includes a smaller allowance to try it out.
landing.faq6_a: You get {days} days with everything unlocked, no card needed. If you don’t subscribe, your files remain in your browser to view, but editing, exporting and AI are locked.
landing.faq6_q: How does the free trial work?
landing.faq7_a: Yes. In Account → Manage subscription you cancel in two clicks and keep access until the end of the paid period. No lock-in.
landing.faq8_a: In US dollars ({usd}/month) or Brazilian reais ({brl}/month), by credit card through Stripe. You choose the currency when you subscribe.
landing.faq8_q: Which currencies can I pay in?
